title: Information Accessibility Limits in Structured NP Search
summary: We study the problem of locating violating principal minors in matrix families lying near the boundary of P-matrices. Rather than viewing this search problem purely through computational complexity, we analyze it from an information-accessibility perspective. We show that, despite strong underlying algebraic structure, the location of a violating subset may remain difficult to infer through local queries.
